We Indians have always been told to save but something has changed.
Our household debt has gone up to be around 40% of the GDP and this seems to keep growing!
In this video we go all the way back to 2015 to understand what changed in India's economy that our behaviour towards debt changed.
We uncover the 3 layer trap that convinced Indians for taking more loans and never come out of it.
Our four star test would help you check if the 3 layer trap has impacted your financial health or are you in the safe zone.
